title: [Keyboard Manager] Only apply to a specific app not available for non-chorded key triggers
author: P-terroir
summary: The new editor exposes app scoping only for shortcut triggers; app-specific single-key remapping is an existing feature request tracked in #6756.
next_action: Consolidate app-specific single-key remapping under #6756 and separately guard the misleading editor state.

confidence.rationale: The public discussion and linked ownership evidence support this classification.

judgment.rationale: Application-specific filtering for single-key triggers is not currently supported; the requested capability is the enhancement tracked in #6756 rather than a regression in the new editor.
evidence: The app-specific checkbox becomes available only for shortcut/chord triggers.
Changing a chord back to one key leaves misleading UI state but does not apply the filter.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate app-specific single-key remapping under #6756 and separately guard the misleading editor state.

fix_assessment.rationale: Application-specific single-key remapping is a planned enhancement tracked by #6756, not an independent bug fix.

issue_context.summary: The new editor exposes app scoping only for shortcut triggers; app-specific single-key remapping is an existing feature request tracked in #6756.
known_information: Entering a chord enables the app-specific option.
Changing that trigger back to one key does not make the resulting mapping app-specific.
inferences: The disabled control reflects a product limitation, while retaining an apparently selected app after changing trigger type is a UI validation defect.
issue_context.analysis: The requested capability should not be treated as a new bug design. The editor should avoid implying unsupported scope, but the underlying feature belongs in #6756.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the complete live report and all comments.
Verified #6756 remains the open canonical enhancement.

actions.label: Close as app-specific key-remap duplicate
actions.note: Draft only; no comment, close, label, or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: The app-specific option is currently supported for shortcut/chord triggers, not single-key triggers. That capability is tracked in #6756, so this issue can be closed as a duplicate. The editor should also clear or explain the app scope when a chord is changed back to one key so it does not imply that an unsupported filter will apply.
